meta.name: Omada incident/anomaly dictionary
meta.method: Site Incidents > Settings JSON, read-only. Per-instance enable flags removed. Names and definitions from the Omada controller web UI bundle (Settings-page incident dictionary; version per README).

levelMapping.basis: Inference: the Settings JSON statistic counts for critical/error/warning/info match the number of rows at level 0/1/2/3. Labels are from the UI bundle (INCIDENT_CRITICAL, INCIDENT_ERROR, INCIDENT_WARNING, INCIDENT_INFO and ABNORMAL_SETTINGS).

categoryMapping.basis: Inference: the Settings JSON numbers categories 11–19 with no names. The UI bundle (ABNORMAL_INCIDENT) lists these nine labels. Each captured type's UI title belongs to exactly one of those categories, and the JSON category number follows this order. The bundle has no literal 11: Access assignment.

meta.paramsObserved: Parameter values as returned in the Settings snapshot. These are observed values (typically the controller defaults), not a record of a site's policy. Units are taken from the UI definition text.
